description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FineractEntityAccessNotFoundException' used to indicate that a specific entity access resource was not found within the application. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors to create exceptions with either an ID or a code name.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass representing a 'not found' error specific to entity access resources in Fineract.

methods.name: FineractEntityAccessNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for a specific entity access ID, with a message indicating the ID does not exist.

methods.name: FineractEntityAccessNotFoundException(String codeName)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for a specific entity access identified by a code name, with a message indicating it does not exist.
